text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
At last, my entry as the "Overlord" into 
the Twinkle Series has been decided. The 
time has come to illuminate the masses 
with my radiance!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the pinnacle of the Twinkle 
Series, I'm giving practice everything 
I've got! From endurance runs... to my 
victory speech, I'm fully primed and ready 
to roll!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
—Now, the prologue to the 'Rise of the 
End-of-Century Overlord' begins.
